title: Are long planks a waste of time? ⏱️
caption:
A plank trains your core to stop your back from sagging. Several 10-second hard holds with perfect form beat one shaky 5-minute hold. What is your plank record? 👇

Exercise Series, Part 10
first_comment: Drop your longest plank time. No lying 😤
sources: McGill SM. Low Back Disorders: Evidence-Based Prevention and Rehabilitation, 3rd ed. Human Kinetics 2016 (short repeated holds, e.g. 10 s)
Calatayud J et al. Progression of core stability exercises based on the extent of muscle activity. Am J Phys Med Rehabil 2017;96:694-699
Schoenfeld BJ et al. Muscle activation during low- versus high-load resistance training in well-trained men. Eur J Appl Physiol 2014 (background: activation, not hold time, drives the stimulus)
